rules.sentence: Vital sign abnormalities, such as hypotension, may indicate hypovolemia or an acute bleed.
Obtain labs to evaluate hemoglobin and hematocrit in patients where hypovolemia or anemia is suspected.
Consider sources of bleeding, such as gastrointestinal bleeding and menorrhagia, as these may not be immediately apparent on exam.
